question_en: List science fiction collections with exactly 3 movies
question_fr: Répertorier les collections de science-fiction avec exactement 3 films
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_NAME, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_SOURCE, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.WIKIPEDIA_IMAGE_PATH, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.OVERVIEW, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.MOVIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.SERIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.IMDB_RATING FROM T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_MOVIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_GENRE = 878 GROUP BY T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_NAME, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_SOURCE, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.WIKIPEDIA_IMAGE_PATH, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.OVERVIEW, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.MOVIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.SERIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.IMDB_RATING HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE) = 3 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 8
